headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.title: 广州推出首个现房销售试点
headlines.summary: 7月29日，广州市规划和自然资源局南沙区分局公开挂牌出让一宗住宅用地的使用权，要求竞得者承诺在其中一个地块执行现房销售，而地方政府则给予土地出让金分期缴纳的支持。南沙区住房和城乡建设局相关人士表示，这是广州首个将“现房销售承诺制”纳入出让条件的住宅项目，有效解决了“能否按时交房”的信任问题，下一步，该区将有序扩大现房销售承诺制试点范围，在更多优质地块推广这一模式，加快形成可复制经验。（中国房地产报）

headlines.title_en: Guangzhou launches first cash-sale pilot project
headlines.summary_en: On July 29, the Nansha Branch of the Guangzhou Municipal Bureau of Planning and Natural Resources publicly listed a residential land use right for auction, requiring the winner to commit to spot sales on one plot, with local government support for deferred land transfer fee payments. A Nansha District Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau official said this is Guangzhou's first residential project incorporating a 'spot sales commitment system' into sale conditions, effectively addressing trust issues over 'timely delivery'. Next, the district plans to orderly expand the spot sales commitment pilot to more quality plots, accelerating replicable experiences. (China Real Estate News)

headlines.title: 业内人士：多重因素扰动，金价短期走势或以震荡为主
headlines.summary: 自6月下旬以来，伦敦现货黄金价格在4000美元/盎司附近反复拉锯。与之形成鲜明反差的是，7月以来A股黄金股率先“躁动”，部分龙头黄金股涨幅超过30%，明显跑赢同期金价。业内人士认为，当前金价中长期支撑逻辑并未发生根本改变，央行购金仍可能推动金价中枢逐步上移，黄金类资产依旧具备配置价值。但短期来看，市场仍面临全球流动性、美联储政策预期、地缘局势以及市场资金流向等多重因素扰动，或以震荡走势为主。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Insiders: Multiple factors cause disturbance, gold price short-term trend likely volatile
headlines.summary_en: Since late June, London spot gold prices have oscillated around $4,000 per ounce. In stark contrast, A-share gold stocks have been 'stirring' since July, with some leading gold stocks rising over 30%, significantly outperforming gold prices in the same period. Insiders believe the medium-to-long-term support logic for gold prices has not fundamentally changed, and central bank gold purchases may still push the gold price center gradually upward, with gold assets retaining allocation value. However, in the short term, the market faces multiple factors such as global liquidity, Fed policy expectations, geopolitical situations, and market capital flows, likely leading to volatile trends. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: “翻倍基”数量锐减 绩优基金之间差距拉开
headlines.summary: 截至7月28日，年内收益率超过100%的基金仅剩6只，较6月末的246只减少240只。不足一个月，上半年批量涌现的“翻倍基”数量缩水97.56%。“翻倍基”阵营快速缩水的背后，是前期领涨的科技板块遭遇集体调整。7月以来，创业板50指数、科创50指数分别下跌23.16%、23.97%，市场由单边上涨转向高位震荡，重仓人工智能、半导体、通信等方向的基金首当其冲。值得注意的是，剧烈波动也进一步拉开了绩优基金之间的差距。部分基金因持仓高度集中而大幅回吐收益，还有部分基金凭借提前降低仓位、调整持仓结构，继续守在“翻倍线”之上。

headlines.title_en: Number of ‘double-bagger’ funds sharply declines, gap widens among top-performing funds.
headlines.summary_en: As of July 28, only six funds had year-to-date returns exceeding 100%, down from 246 at the end of June, a drop of 240. In less than a month, the number of 'double-your-money' funds that surged in H1 shrank by 97.56%. Behind the rapid shrinkage of 'double-your-money' funds was a collective correction in previously leading tech sectors. Since July, the Chinext 50 index and STAR 50 index have fallen 23.16% and 23.97% respectively, with the market shifting from a one-sided rally to high-level volatility, hitting funds heavily weighted in AI, semiconductor, communications and similar areas hard. Notably, the sharp volatility has further widened the gap among top-performing funds. Some funds have seen large profit givebacks due to highly concentrated holdings, while others, by reducing positions early and adjusting portfolio structures, have stayed above the 'double-your-money' line.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年文化企业营业收入平稳增长
headlines.summary: 上半年，各地区各部门认真贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，积极推动文化高质量发展若干经济政策落地显效，促进文化产业提质增效，着力扩大文化产品和服务消费，文化企业营业收入实现平稳增长，文化新业态行业展现蓬勃活力。规模以上文化企业营业收入平稳增长。上半年，全国规模以上文化及相关产业企业实现营业收入72026亿元，比上年同期增长4.6%。分领域看，文化核心领域实现营业收入50472亿元，比上年同期增长5.5%。其中，文化投资运营、新闻信息服务、创意设计服务等3个行业大类营业收入实现较快增长，增速分别为10.0%、9.2%和9.2%。（国家统计局）

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Cultural enterprise revenue grew steadily in first half of year.
headlines.summary_en: In H1, all regions and departments earnestly implemented the decisions and deployments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, actively pushed for the implementation and effectiveness of several economic policies for high-quality cultural development, promoted cultural industry quality and efficiency, focused on expanding cultural product and service consumption, achieving steady revenue growth for cultural enterprises, with new cultural industry formats showing vibrant vitality. Revenue of large-scale cultural enterprises grew steadily. In H1, large-scale cultural and related industry enterprises nationwide achieved revenue of 7.2026 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year. By segment, the core cultural sector achieved revenue of 5.0472 trillion yuan, up 5.5% year-on-year. Among them, three major industries—cultural investment and operation, news information services, and creative design services—saw faster revenue growth, with rates of 10.0%, 9.2%, and 9.2% respectively. (National Bureau of Statistics)
